title: The 4 Best Baby Bottles Under $30
metaDescription: Our 4 picks for baby bottles under $30, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at baby bottles under $30 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Philips Avent Natural Baby Bottles, Medium Flow, 4-Pack
products.blurb: Key specs: 9oz capacity, medium flow nipple, Wide, breast-shaped nipple, AirFree anti-colic valve.
strengths: Lowest per-bottle cost of the three 4-packs here at typical retail pricing
Fewest parts of any bottle in this list, the fastest to wash across a full 4-bottle rotation
limitations: AirFree valve only vents fully when held mostly vertical
Uniform 9oz size means no smaller newborn-size bottle included in this specific pack
Nipple collapse reported occasionally at faster flow levels

products.name: Dr. Brown's Options+ Narrow Glass Baby Bottles, 4-Pack
products.blurb: Key specs: 8oz and 4oz sizes included in one pack, Internal vent system that routes air away from milk, Borosilicate glass, BPA-free.
strengths: Mixed 8oz and 4oz sizing covers both newborn and older-infant feeds from a single purchase
Glass construction resists odor and staining better than plastic over years of use
Vent system carries the deepest anti-colic research history in this category
limitations: Most parts per bottle of any brand here, more to wash across a full rotation
Glass bottles are heavier and can chip if dropped on tile
features: 8oz and 4oz sizes included in one pack
Internal vent system that routes air away from milk

products.name: Comotomo Baby Bottle, Double Pack, 5oz
products.blurb: Key specs: 100% medical-grade silicone body, Wide neck for brushless hand washing, Dual anti-colic vents.
strengths: Silicone body's soft texture is the most breast-like feel of any bottle in this price range
Wide opening makes hand washing fast without a brush, useful with only 2 bottles in rotation
limitations: Only 2 bottles per pack at this price, versus 4 from Avent or Dr.
Silicone shows fingerprints and grip marks faster than hard plastic
Wide barrel does not fit every bottle warmer
features: Wide neck for brushless hand washing
Typically $24 to $27 for a double pack
